OUT-OF-CHARACTER INDUCTIONS ARE CARRIED BY THE CHARACTER (founder's gavel, 2026-09-02; CURATION v108): a community hall that inducts real handlers under their own names is filed here by the characters those handlers wrote, with a per-row note saying so — the recognition is carried, the name is withheld. Where no character can be established from the record, the seat itself is recorded as "a handler (name withheld under the privacy rule)" with the federation the inducting document credits, so the seat is not lost. `inductee` may therefore be an entity id or the honest { name, unminted: true, fed? } shape reigns.json and awards.json already use.

inductions.source: ACW's own Hall of Fame page (its Class of 2009, served at /promotions/acw/archive/acw-hall-of-fame-class-of-2009.html) and End Game 2009 (booking 3382; the fed's own write-up of the night, served at /promotions/acw/archive/acw-end-game-2009-12-17.html): the Hall of Fame page lists Aaron 'SilverHAWK' Jones in the Class of 2009 as inducted both as a superstar and as an architect; on the night James Boyd presents him as the third Architect in ACW and the segment closes "The Architects of ACW: Charles Dunn, James Boyd and Aaron 'SilverHAWK' Jones."
inductions.note: Inducted into ACW's own Hall of Fame on End Game 2009, the Class of 2009, as the third Architect of ACW (the fed's own wording).

inductions.source: ACW's own Hall of Fame page (its Class of 2009, served at /promotions/acw/archive/acw-hall-of-fame-class-of-2009.html) and End Game 2009 (booking 3382; the fed's own write-up of the night, served at /promotions/acw/archive/acw-end-game-2009-12-17.html): SilverHAWK announces "We are all here tonight because of two men, and those men are Charles Dunn and James Boyd" and that the two "will be passed into the Hall of Fame" as the Architects of ACW; the Hall of Fame page lists them together as the Founding Fathers of ACW and the co-owners of ACW from January 2001 to December 2003.
inductions.note: Inducted jointly with James Boyd as an Architect of ACW, the Class of 2009.
